messages: Mia: Quick thread: we keep getting questions about how to show required vs optional across different console screens. want to land guidance that balances scanability + a11y. thoughts? Sam: my 2c: show minimal UI in dense lists (only mark optional fields), but in full-page forms show required badges next to labels. avoids clutter and answers the common "is this needed?" question. Jordan: important a11y point: visual markers alone aren't enough. always include programmatic hint (aria-required or aria-describedby). sample we should reference: ` Required field` Ana: Error handling: inline errors for field-level fixes, but for flows > 8 fields we should render a compact error summary at the top that links to each invalid field. keyboard users can jump via anchor links. :link: Priya: Microcopy: lead with the issue, then the fix. e.g. 'Password too short' then 'Use 10+ characters including a number'. short actionable text wins. also avoid starting with "Error:" — screen readers will already announce role=alert. Kevin: Destructive confirmations: reserve typed-confirm for org-level irreversible ops. For item-level deletes prefer a confirmation modal + undo toast. Also add a rate-limited safety: if a user triggers >3 deletes in 10m in the UI, surface a stronger guardrail. Mia: Mobile caveat: typed-confirm is brutal on small keyboards. fallback patterns: checkbox + CTA confirmation + undo. We should document mobile-first alternatives. Sam: small CSS note for the required-optional pattern: when most fields are required, invert treatment: show a top banner "All fields required unless labeled optional" and then label optional fields with an "Optional" microcopy. Jordan: Also add an accessibility checklist in the docs: 1) form role & aria-describedby for errors 2) aria-required on required inputs 3) error summary links focus to field 4) color contrast for pills/asterisks 5) screen-reader text for asterisk meaning. Ana: Mock reqs: 3 comps please: (A) dense list/table (mark only optional), (B) full form with Required badge + inline errors + top summary, (C) destructive flow demo showing modal + typed-confirm variant + mobile fallback. Can someone pick up (C)? Kevin: I can do (C) with copy. will include keyboard and screen-reader behaviors and a small interaction spec for the undo toast (5s + dismiss). Priya: I'll draft microcopy variants and post examples (short vs explanatory) to the card. Mia: Thanks — I'll create a ticket with acceptance criteria and link mocks. goal: consensus by end of sprint. :sparkles:
